completion_criteria: An orchestrator parent retained on the current target cannot authorize unresolved bounded-child implementation locally.

Each bounded child has a consequential binding disposition: selected-current executes locally, selected-nonlocal dispatches through the existing revision-bound transport, unavailable recovers or blocks, and unresolved routes to smallest decomposition/assignment action.
Direct single-slice work still receives local execution authority without mandatory decomposition.
Compact ordinary output preserves the child authority/gate needed to prevent a bare execute-here interpretation.
Focused deterministic contracts and maintained real-session evidence satisfy #2817 without adding a parallel regression suite.
The stacked PR is based on PR #2945 and contains a release note and honest proof/claim boundary.
